column1: # **A lottery on the shop's barks.** `shops.md` Section 8.A's shared closing
# envelope draws "one of four `SHOPPE.DAT` records from the current shop-kind"
# row, and the entry greeting draws from its own pool the same way. `prng.md`
# Section 3 seeds the two sides from the host clock, so which member of a pool
# each side draws is not comparable - and because the greeting is the first
# draw, one disagreement there carries through every later beat of the visit.
# A beat the comparator classifies `variant` has measured nothing and must be
# re-run rather than read as a difference.
# Measured 2026-09-12: every differing beat of this scenario classified
# The arms Sell flow: the browser, a step down it, an offer and its decline,
# a second offer taken, and the exit (cleak/u5-spec#238). The header here used
# to describe the Buy confirmation, which is `shop-arms-buy-confirm`.
# Seeded rather than walked to. The walk-up form of this scenario scripted its
# way in from the town gate, and the resident walks its own schedule while
# those steps run, so the two sides arrived with it in different cells and
# every later beat compared unrelated windows (`cleak/u5-engine#22`).
# `qa/tools/reseed.py` replayed that walk once into the seed named below.
# `shops.md` §2: a shopkeeper's "conversation-contact event also reaches it
# automatically during a town schedule pass, even if the player has issued no
# Talk command", so the first Pass beside the keeper opens the overlay and the
# script drives it from there rather than issuing Talk.
